notes.title: News: Timeline Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Your castle is under attack![/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Protect it from new bosses![/b][/h3]

[b]If you cannot defeat the bosses, perhaps you should travel through timelines to try again.[/b]

By traveling through different timelines, you can unlock new features in all aspects to help defend the castle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416978/d5b9fe50df88fc3c64feca6ce83c67c9c4ab7900.png[/img]

Defeat all the bosses from the Demon Realm to save the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416978/5f1bfa80fd1cff6f24f52c2872ef2f6a6e4944b1.png[/img]

[b][h3]✨What's new[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Timelines[/b] have been added: Travel through timelines to defeat new bosses.
[*] 9 new bosses and related materials have been introduced.
[*] Badges have been added: Defeat the bosses to earn them.
[*] Heroes' max stars have been raised to 20, with approximately 40 powerful new traits added.
[*] The cap for difficulty and building levels has been increased.
[*] More researches can be unlocked in different timelines.
[*] Additional relics and relic upgrade can be unlocked across timelines.
[*] The Ball of Space and Time has been added to dump resources.
[*] 7 new game modes have been added.
[*] A place to dump excess copies and rank XP to provide skill power boost.
[*] A new layer called [b]New World[/b] which can be unlocked after saving the world, allowing players to upgrade badges by defeating the bosses.
[*] More QoL functions have been added to the game.
[*] Minor tweaks and fixes everywhere.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.1.8
notes.content:
* Makes it easier for heroes to level up after level 50
* Fix the building cap increase that is applied before the first ascension
* Fix the auto restart that is applied before purchase
* Add a faster restart option in the Settings
* Minor bug fixes

notes.title: v1.0.1.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Tweak of save export/import
[*] Improve the stability of saving
[*] Both swipe and click are working now
[*] Add auto paper to research tree
[*] A research to slowly gain rubies after reaching daily ruby cap
[*] A research to soft ban heroes from battle
[*] Separate settings for showing/hiding texts
[*] Make it easier to read the research node state
[*] Improve the performance of research tree
[*] Tweak of Nilm's skill to make it less laggy
[*] Shortcut for choose card in one key
[*] Fix Steam achievements progress issue
[*] Fix critical is not working for summon heroes
[*] Fix the Blad attack bug
[*] Fix the Paper Buff issue
[*] The requirements of All For Power and All For Effect are changed a bit
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Refence is finally released
notes.content:
It has been a long time since we released the demo, and "Refence" is finally here.

Thank you all for your enthusiastic support and feedback! We hope you find the same joy in playing it!

If you want to stay in touch with us or give us feedback, please join our Discord group or forum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416978/6d1a1903f146b8e85ef1296226b8549ea24f45cb.png[/img]

Choose your heroes and fight against enemies!

Love you all!

notes.title: Refence v1.0.0-RC2
notes.content:
* 添加了新的战场英雄杰斯特
* 英雄攻击范围始终最大化
* 设置了后期游戏的最大敌人数量
* 调整了英雄召唤几率，史诗和传奇英雄的召唤几率更高
* 一些随机的视觉调整
* 添加了一些随机内容
* 修复了一些小错误和拼写错误。

notes.title: Refence v1.0.0-RC1
notes.content:
* Bump the version name and prepare for the full release
* Reduce the max wave by 20 and add a very cheap max wave research node for a better early game experience
* Add hero Jax to the demo and raise the max difficulty to 3
* Add a research node for choosing between XP and Lv wave rewards
* Add a research node to spawn a wave of goblins
* Remove the shield from Loot Goblin
* Fix the bug where Aella's skill is not working properly at low FPS
* Boost Critical related traits and researches
* Minor bug and typo fixes.
